title: Skip link
summary: The first focusable element on a page: invisible until it takes focus, then a button that jumps past the navigation to the main content.

writes.target: the page element the href points at
writes.why: tabindex=-1 when the target has none, so the click can move focus there. Not removed. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: Target must be a fragment on the same page; the element makes the target focusable so focus really moves.
mobile: Shown with a 44px target when focused by a keyboard or switch device.
